rule_id_policy.description: Each emitted report check is an individual rule conclusion. Its stable rule ID is formed from the suite ID, a colon, and the report check key.

suites.purpose: Cross-table, schema, semantic, longitudinal, sample-design, and release-integrity validation.
Archived City snapshot fidelity, transformation, hash, coordinate, and privacy validation.
Reject workstation paths, private Git email addresses, account names, contact columns, and direct contact values.
Protect frozen inputs and establish deterministic offline analytical output.

manual_review_boundary.statement: Human review outcomes remain record-level judgments and are never relabeled as deterministic automated rules.
